summary_md: **John Robinson ([@johnrobinsn](https://x.com/johnrobinsn/status/2115435919931330985))** built **MacVoice**, a full voice loop on a MacBook running on a local LLM: you can talk over the agent to interrupt it, the first spoken word arrives ~0.7 s after you stop, and it fits in 1.4 GB without PyTorch. The self-thread covers Smart Turn end-of-speech detection (1,504 ms to 288 ms), dropping torch (5.4 GB to 1.3 GB), macOS echo cancellation, and pointing it at any OpenAI-compatible server or an ACP coding agent.

referenced_urls.title: A Local Voice Agent on a MacBook in Under 2 GB
GitHub - johnrobinsn/macvoice: A local voice agent loop for Apple Silicon in under 2 GB: Silero VAD, Smart Turn, Parakeet (MLX), Phonon. No PyTorch. Bring your own LLM, or Claude Code over ACP.

relevance: Low-latency local voice front end that can drive coding agents.
